answer: Every key locks a 400,000 POA bond, withdrawable only after a 30-epoch window in which claims still apply. Any holder may stake 20,000 POA to claim that two keys share a funding ancestor within 3 hops, exchanges excluded by list; a rejected claim burns the stake. An upheld claim slashes both bonds, 800,000 POA: half burned, half to the claimant. Per key the price is 400,000 POA locked, linear in n: 1,000 fakes tie up 400 million. An opal of rented wallets, a violet of fresh keys or a nectar of idle accounts cannot dodge it, unless origins differ, then each pays its own bond.
